Hi Sanjay — great, received the W-9 and bank stub. I've attached our procurement "starter pack" which lists exactly what we need to create a vendor record and issue the first PO. TL;DR below so you can action quickly.

What we need from you (please return within 5 business days if possible):
- Completed vendor intake form (attached in starter pack: page 2)
- Signed supplier terms (we accept DocuSign) or a redline set if you have changes
- Remit-to/billing email and preferred invoice format (PDF preferred, single file per invoice)
- W-9 (received) and bank details (received)
- Contact for invoice escalation and a purchase order mailing address (if different from billing email)

What you'll get from Redwood:
- PO issuance within 3 business days after vendor record is complete and terms are agreed
- Invoices processed on Net 30 by default; if you need Net 45/60 please flag in the intake form for review
- Primary PO contact: Karthik Iyer (cc'd) — he issues the PO and confirms PO number

Next steps: Please review the starter pack and either sign the supplier terms via DocuSign or send a marked-up redline. If there are commercial terms to discuss (billing cadence, payment terms), let us know and we'll route to Finance for approval.

I've attached: redwood_procurement_starter_pack.pdf (includes intake form and standard terms)

Best,
